pages.name: Salon and barber
pages.title: Salon and barber booking software with online deposits | ZexCore
pages.description: Give clients one link to book a service, pick a stylist and pay a deposit through Paystack. Reminders go out by email and every client has a record.
pages.h1: Online booking for salons and barbers
pages.lead: Clients book a haircut, braids or a manicure from a link in your Instagram or WhatsApp bio, and the time lands in your calendar. A deposit holds the slot, so fewer people fail to show up.
points: A booking page you can share
Clients choose a service, a stylist and a time that is actually free. No back-and-forth messages.
A calendar for each stylist
Add your staff as bookable people, each with their own calendar, so two clients are never booked for the same chair.
Deposits that hold the slot
Ask for a deposit when a client books. Card payments go through Paystack to your payout account.
Reminders and follow-ups by email
Clients get a reminder before the appointment. You can also send a thank-you afterwards.
A record for every client
See each client's past visits and notes, and message them from one inbox.
steps: Name each service with its length and price, for example Braids, 4 hours.
Put it in your Instagram bio, WhatsApp status or on a card at the till.
Deposits are collected online and your day appears on the calendar.
faq: Can clients pick their stylist?
Yes. Add each stylist as bookable staff and clients can choose who they want to book with.
Does ZexCore take a fee on payments?

Yes. Online deposits and shop payments carry a small ZexCore fee, and Paystack's own processing fee is separate. The fee depends on your plan and is shown on the pricing page and in your settings before you turn payments on.
Can I start without paying?
Yes. You can start on the free plan, set up your services and share your booking link. You only upgrade if you outgrow the free limits.
